news.summary: SpaceX's first earnings call as a public company may be expected to focus on AI spending and profits from its Starlink satellite communications network, but many retail investors have other ‌things on their minds.  Taking a page from Elon Musk's other big company, Tesla, newly public rocket maker SpaceX ‌has opened an online venue for investors to ask questions ahead of a call about results that is expected to feature Musk.  Among the most popular shareholder questions submitted ahead of Tuesday's call were requests for more footage of Starship's Human Landing System, the vehicle designed to carry astronauts to the moon for NASA's Artemis program next year.

news.title: 'Tech Titan' Arora spearheads $1bn shot at NBA's London basketball team
news.summary: The US technology billionaire who led the acquisition of English cricket's most lucrative Hundred franchise is in talks to buy London's new NBA Europe team.  Sky News has learnt that Nikesh Arora, chief executive of the New York-listed cybersecurity firm Palo Alto Networks, is on a list of bidders being considered to acquire the latest addition to the capital's sports line-up.  Mr Arora last year assembled a group which instantly became known as the 'Tech Titans' when it bought a 49% stake in the Lords-based London Spirit Hundred team.
